summary_en: AGS Corporation executed a block acquisition of 100,000 shares (0.6% of outstanding shares) at 1,031 yen per share via ToSTNeT-3 on November 2, 2026, for a total of 103.1 million yen.
title_en: Notice Regarding Acquisition of Treasury Stock and Purchase of Treasury Stock via Off-Market Trading (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief:
On October 30, 2026, AGS Corporation's Board of Directors authorized the execution of a treasury stock acquisition via off-market trading (ToSTNeT-3). The company purchased 100,000 shares of its common stock at a fixed price of 1,031 yen per share on November 2, 2026, for a total investment of 103.1 million yen. This represented 0.6% of the company's outstanding shares (calculated as 100,000 divided by 16,708,732 outstanding shares excluding treasury stock as of September 30, 2026).

The acquisition was executed through ToSTNeT-3, an off-market trading system, with the purchase order placed for the specific trading session on November 2, 2026 at 8:45 AM. The fixed purchase price of 1,031 yen reflected the closing price (including final special quotations) of the stock on October 30, 2026.

The company stated that the acquisition was undertaken to enhance shareholder returns, improve capital efficiency, and enable flexible capital policy implementation in response to changing business environments.
